displayName: Guitar Coach API - RabbitMQ dead-letter growth

documentation.content: Any message has been dead-lettered in the last 15 minutes. Backed by queue_dead_lettered_total (src/routines/events/routine-created.consumer.ts). At current traffic volume, any dead-lettering is worth investigating — the routine.created consumer is currently a logging placeholder with no business logic that should legitimately fail. Check the routine_events.dlq queue depth in the RabbitMQ management UI (already enabled, see compose.yaml) for the actual backlog. VERIFY the metric.type filter below in Metrics Explorer before applying (see docs/monitoring/README.md).
